hypothesis: Intraday time-series momentum: the sign of the move from the session open to open+h predicts the return from open+h to the session close, on every locally available futures market, with one common specification. Expected sign: positive net expectancy of following the move, larger when the move is large relative to its recent typical size.
disclosure_before_freeze: No return of this strategy was computed on any real instrument before the freeze. The runner was validated on synthetic data only (self-test).

Prior information already seen in this repo: (a) close-of-day momentum (prior close -> T-30, last 30 minutes) is CLOSED_COST_CONSTRAINED on 8 instruments; (b) mes_gex_regime_phase1_20261111 implies that following the first hour on MES over 2019-05 -> 2023-12 is roughly zero net (LOW-GEX follow +1.31 USD/trade, HIGH-GEX fade -9.34 USD/trade); (c) volatility_breakout sleeves (entry at open +/- ATR multiple) are live on MNQ, MGC and MBT and are a related mechanism.
6E, ZN and MCL are not tested: their one-minute files are no longer on disk. GC (ends 2023-03) duplicates MGC and is not used.
The 2024-01 -> 2026-03 window was used as OOS by earlier campaigns on other strategies; it is unseen for this hypothesis.

Session coverage was counted before the freeze (counts only, no return): the 75% completeness rule leaves MBT thin in IS (116 sessions in 2021, 162 in 2022, 81 in 2023) and MGC without eligible sessions before 2016-02, so the MGC part of PRE is effectively 2016-02 -> 2019-05. The rule is kept unchanged.

pre_sample_holdout_universe.MGC: same file and contract as in universe

session.bar_semantics: one-minute bars stamped at bar start; minute index m = minutes since session_start, 0 <= m < session_minutes; weekdays only
session.open_price: open of the first bar with 0 <= m <= 4
session.exit_price: close of the last bar with session_minutes-5 <= m <= session_minutes-1
session.eligibility: at least 75% of the session's one-minute bars present, open_price and exit_price available, a single instrument_id over the session (intraday roll excluded). Half days fail the exit_price condition.

signal.s_h: ln(signal_price_h / open_price), signal_price_h = close of the last bar with h-5 <= m <= h-1
signal.sigma_h: sqrt(mean of s_h^2 over the 20 previous eligible sessions), at least 15 values required (causal)
signal.sigma_day: sqrt(mean of ln(exit_price/open_price)^2 over the 20 previous eligible sessions), at least 15 values required (causal)
signal.direction: sign(s_h) if abs(s_h) >= k * sigma_h and s_h != 0, else no trade
signal.entry: open of the first bar with h <= m <= h+4; no trade if absent
signal.exit: exit_price; no stop, no target, one trade per session at most

grid.note: The grid is identical on every instrument. No per-asset parameter.

costs.rule: 1 tick slippage per side + commission per side; round trip USD = 2 * tick_size * point_value + 2 * commission_per_side

unit: R = net_return / sigma_day (risk-normalised). USD per contract is reported alongside.

pooling.rule: per day, average R across eligible instruments inside each cluster (no trade = 0), then average across clusters that have at least one eligible instrument that day
pooling.reason: MNQ, MES and M2K are one bet; cluster balancing stops the equity index from counting three times

selection_rule.statistic: daily Sharpe (mean/std) of the pooled net R series on IS for each cell, then neighbourhood smoothing: average of the cell and its orthogonal neighbours on the (h, k) grid
selection_rule.choice: the single cell with the highest smoothed Sharpe; ties broken by lower h then lower k
selection_rule.executed: that one cell, the same on every instrument

tests_on_IS.hac: Newey-West t of the mean of the pooled net R series, 5 lags, all eligible days (no-trade days = 0)
tests_on_IS.max_stat_permutation: 5000 draws; each draw flips the trade direction of whole days (same flip for every instrument and cell, costs still paid); statistic = maximum smoothed Sharpe over the 15 cells; p = share of draws >= observed. Controls for the 15-cell search and for cross-asset correlation. Seed 20261111.
tests_on_IS.cscv: 12 contiguous time blocks, all 924 half/half splits; the selection rule is applied on the train half; logit of the relative rank of the chosen cell's Sharpe on the test half; PBO = share of splits with logit <= 0
diagnostics_not_gated: per-instrument and per-cluster table for all 15 cells
entry delayed by one extra bar

all_required: G1: selected cell pooled IS mean net R > 0 with HAC t >= 2.0
G4: selected cell net mean R > 0 on IS in at least 2 of 3 clusters and at least 3 of 5 instruments
G5: more than half of IS calendar years have a positive pooled net sum
G6: selected cell on PRE (NQ 2010-06 -> 2019-05 with NQ costs, MGC 2015-01 -> 2019-05, cluster-balanced) has mean net R > 0 with HAC t >= 1.0
gate_to_OOS.if_pass: the user is asked before OOS is read; the same code and the same selected cell are then applied once to OOS as a verdict
gate_to_OOS.if_fail: OOS is not computed; hypothesis closed on this data

pass_if_all: pooled OOS mean net R > 0 with HAC t >= 1.0
net mean R > 0 in at least 2 of 3 clusters
oos_verdict.EXT: reported for MNQ, MGC and MBT only, informational, not part of the verdict

prohibitions: no other window, threshold, reference price, exit, stop or filter after the freeze
no OOS before the IS gate is evaluated and the user has approved the read
